results.title: Tacoma-based Bruno's European Restaurant to close after decades of service
results.description: Bruno's European Restaurant in Tacoma will soon close its doors as owners Krystyna and Bruno decide to retire. The establishment, known for its traditional German and Polish cuisine and featured on Diners Drive-Ins and Dives in 2013, will bid farewell to its loyal customer base. The couple informed staff of the closure during a September event and plans to focus on their health after years of running the family business.

results.title: Hamdan bin Mohammed meets World Economic Forum President and CEO to discuss future leadership and global cooperation
results.description: Dubai: His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Defence of the UAE, and Chairman of The Executive Council of Dubai, met today with Alois Zwinggi, President and CEO of the World Economic Forum. His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum also attended the meeting, which took place on the sidelines of the Annual Meeting of Global Future Leaders 2026. The meeting explored the longstanding partnership between the UAE Government and the World Economic Forum, as well as their shared commitment to shaping the future. During the meeting, Sheikh Hamdan reaffirmed the UAE’s commitment to expanding international dialogue among experts, innovators and decision-makers to anticipate the trends shaping the future. His Highness also noted that the participation of more than 700 decision-makers, experts, officials, specialists and young leaders in the Annual Meeting of Global Future Leaders in Dubai reflects the shared vision of the UAE and the World Economic Forum to empower the next generation of leaders. It also reinforces the positions of the UAE and Dubai as global hubs for international initiatives that equip future leaders to make a greater impact in shaping the future. The meeting was also attended by His Excellency Mohammad bin Abdullah Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs; His Excellency Omar Sultan Al Olama, Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence, Digital Economy and Remote Work Applications; Her Excellency Ohood bint Khalfan Al Roumi, Minister of State for Government Development and the Future; and His Excellency Khalfan Belhoul, CEO of the Dubai Future Foundation.
